name: Kiro Web
desc: Kiro's browser workspace for delegating code work that runs in cloud sessions.
desc_zh: Kiro 的浏览器工作区，用来派发在云端会话中运行的编码任务。
solves: Some work starts away from your laptop; Kiro Web opens a session from any browser and the agent writes code and opens pull requests.
solves_zh: 有些活儿不在笔记本旁就开始；Kiro Web 让你在任意浏览器开会话，智能体写代码并提 PR。
best_for: A teammate flags a bug in Slack while you are between meetings and you want it fixed before you sit back down.
best_for_zh: 会议间隙同事在 Slack 里报了一个 bug，你想在坐下之前就把它派出去时。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — kiro.dev blog feed and product directory）。 Launched in preview 2026-05-18 for Pro, Pro+ and Power. Kiro IDE and Kiro CLI added autonomous workflows in the following weeks, so the surfaces share one account and one credit pool. 首次公开日期来源：https://kiro.dev/blog/introducing-kiro-web/
